sources.title: GPT-4 Passes the Bar Exam: What That Means for Artificial Intelligence ...
sources.excerpt: GPT-4 not only passed but approached 90th percentile

reasoning: Multiple academic and legal studies have confirmed that GPT-4 successfully passed the Uniform Bar Examination (UBE). Research by Bommarito and Katz demonstrated that GPT-4 not only exceeded the minimum passing threshold but also performed in the high percentiles (approaching the 90th percentile), significantly outperforming the average human test-taker on multiple-choice questions.
